description: Return a short static comparison of HefestoAI with one named tool. Use it when the user asks how HefestoAI differs from another scanner. No live lookup and no code is inspected. All arguments are optional: {} compares with sonarqube. Known values: sonarqube (the default when tool is omitted), snyk, github-advanced-security, semgrep, claude-code-security, coderabbit, qodo. Any other value is answered as sonarqube.

tool.description: Optional. Tool to compare with: sonarqube (default), snyk, github-advanced-security, semgrep, claude-code-security, coderabbit, or qodo.

name: compare

outputSchema.description: Static comparison. tool is the known value actually answered (unknown names are sonarqube). text is the content text.

text.description: Comparison paragraph. Same string as content[0].text.

tool.description: sonarqube, snyk, github-advanced-security, semgrep, claude-code-security, coderabbit, or qodo.

title: Compare tools
